one_liner: attempted to complete dispatch on staging-admin
summary:
The task was to find a way to complete dispatch for the current outbound order on staging-admin without leaving the order page.
The order’s status was checked before the attempt and showed "Waiting for Dispatch."
A dispatch completion option was attempted on the order page.
No confirmation dialog appeared, and no validation errors were shown during the attempt.
After the attempt, the order status still showed "Waiting for Dispatch," so the dispatch was not completed and the order did not change to "Shipped."
